name: rizzerbot
description: Professional and Modular WhatsApp Bot built with Baileys

scripts.prestart: node -e "import fs from 'fs'; const sym = 'node_modules/@'; if (fs.existsSync(sym)) { try { fs.rmSync(sym, { recursive: true, force: true }); } catch (_) {} } fs.symlinkSync('../', sym, 'junction')"
scripts.postinstall: node -e "import fs from 'fs'; const sym = 'node_modules/@'; if (fs.existsSync(sym)) { try { fs.rmSync(sym, { recursive: true, force: true }); } catch (_) {} } fs.symlinkSync('../', sym, 'junction')"
